description: This database gathers water production, wastewater treatment and the energy they require for US cities, collected through open records requests over two years. Christopher Chini and Ashlynn Stillwell of the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign published it on HydroShare in February 2018, with papers in the Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management and Water Resources Research. Coverage is 127 cities in 253 water and sewer districts, chosen as cities over 100,000 people plus the largest city in each remaining state, serving 81.4 million drinking water and 86.2 million wastewater customers, at daily or monthly resolution where available. Average demand was 560 litres per person per day for drinking water and 500 for wastewater, with embedded energy of 340 and 430 kWh per 1000 cubic metres. Format and access: tabular files on HydroShare. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: record periods and resolution vary between utilities. It supports capacity planning and energy-water interdependency models of urban utilities. Related catalogue records are IBNET water utility benchmarking and NYC Local Law 84 energy and water benchmarking.
